title: Refine
description: How the harness refines itself: snags read by what they touched, so a refiner can propose a pack change for what keeps getting in the way. A snag names what it touched in touches, a field each snag's type declares in its own pack (an issue's, in the work pack).

rules.say: "{title}": touches names what a snag touched as kind:ref, separated by spaces: pack:<id>, instruction:<id>, tool:<name>, rule:<id>, view:<name>, hook:<event> or page:<name>.

views.description: Open snags grouped by what they touched (touches: pack:, instruction:, tool:, rule:, view:, hook:, page:), the most first: each group with its count, its highest severity, its snags and the runs that wrote them, with the packs they ran under. Params: within (an item id, such as the friction feature: every open snag inside it, those that name nothing counted under untouched); without it, the open snags that name what they touched; types (the types read as snags; issue unless said).

within.description: An item id: the open snags inside it, at any depth.

types.description: The types read as snags: issue unless said.

actions.title: Hold briefs for a replay
actions.description: Hold the briefs of 5 to 10 finished tasks on a replay set (the replays pack's), so they run again under another pack version and are compared like with like. Names a set to add to, or a title for a new one; a task the set holds keeps its brief.

set.description: The replay set to add to. Left out, a new one is made.

tasks.description: Finished tasks, by id, each in a repository with a local path.

actions.title: Replay a set
actions.description: Run every held brief of a replay set again, each a session on this machine, under the pack version named (<pack>@<version>, the one this map runs). Each run names the set and the version, so two versions' runs are told apart. A person's action: it starts sessions.

version.description: The pack version it runs under, as <pack>@<version>: refused where this map runs another.

mode.description: plan (the default): read and investigate only. acceptEdits: may edit files in the repository.

instructions.description: Anything to add to every brief.

styles.title: Say what a bump touched
styles.body: A bump is recorded as an issue part_of the friction feature (search type feature, q friction). Put what it touched in its touches: one or more of pack:<id>, instruction:<id>, tool:<name>, rule:<id>, view:<name>, hook:<event> or page:<name>, separated by spaces. A refusal names its rule, so rule:<that id>. The snags view groups bumps by it.
